title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition plays a crucial role in ensuring the health of both mother and baby. A balanced and varied diet will provide the necessary nutrients for fetal development. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnant women, helping to build balanced and safe meals.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnant Women
The following international pantry staples are excellent choices for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, supporting digestive health and reducing the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, supporting the development of the fetus's bones and teeth.
- Lentils: rich in iron, supporting fetal development and reducing the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, supporting the development of the fetus's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, supporting fetal development and reducing the risk of nutrient deficiencies.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, supporting the immune system and reducing the risk of disease.

## Combining International Pantry Staples into Meals
To combine these international pantry staples into meals, you can try the following:
- Add oats to breakfast with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Use lentils in stews and soups.
- Cook low-mercury salmon with leafy greens and citrus.
- Add eggs to breakfast with whole grain bread and leafy greens.
- Use leafy greens and citrus in salads and juices.

## Food Safety Considerations
When using international pantry staples, it is essential to consider food safety. Ensure that:
- Foods are cooked thoroughly before consumption.
- Foods are stored properly to avoid contamination.
- Foods are sourced from reputable suppliers.

## Conclusion
International pantry staples can help build balanced and safe meals for pregnant women. Try combining these foods into your meals and consider food safety guidelines.
